Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GS.
Our gross margin expanded by 169 basis points to 27.8%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $24.9 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2023.
Our cloud segment grew 8% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 169 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We generated $12.7 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 8% to 15% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
